label: Uneasy calm
summary: The Gulf stayed tense: the US struck Iran's Qeshm island after Iranian drones targeted a US radar in Bahrain, and Kuwait reported drone attacks. What Russia called Ukraine's largest drone attack of the war targeted the Kerch bridge, killing two in Crimea, even as Kyiv held peace talks with US and European officials. The Gaza Board of Peace warned the ceasefire could collapse without action, and fighting continued in eastern DR Congo. The US formally lost its measles-free status after 26 years. Wall Street fell for a fourth day before Nvidia beat forecasts after the close. Brighter notes: Quad partners agreed critical-minerals deals in Manila, Air Niugini resumed PNG–New Zealand flights after 26 years, Fela Kuti entered the Rock Hall, and researchers unveiled a reusable carbon-capture material. The weighted formula gave 44; no editorial adjustment.
